added.summary: A class `nine-<name>` draws the pack image of that name as the element's box art (nine-sliced, a `tint: true` image coloured by the element's fill), under any variant: `hover:nine-plate-lit` holds only on hover, the last holding one wins. `og check` reports a name the pack lacks.
`<Image src={texture}>` draws a texture from `og.load.texture` over its box; `src` is the texture handle, not a string.

`wipe`, `wipeStart` and `wipeCcw` props on any element with a box image (an `Image`'s `src` or a `nine-<name>` class) wipe it radially: the share shown 0 to 1, bound per tick, from `wipeStart` radians (0 up), clockwise unless `wipeCcw`. Cooldowns and progress rings use it.

`text-stroke-<number>` or `text-stroke-[<length>]` outlines text with a stroke of that width under its fill, in the text's colour or `text-stroke-<color>`'s. Inline styles take `-webkit-text-stroke-width` and `-color`.
